_note: BUD = ADR US d'AB InBev (primary ABI.BR Brussels). Plus grand brasseur mondial.

kpis.description_fr: Volumes totaux AB InBev 580 Mhl en 2024. #1 brasseur mondial, brassés dans 50+ pays via 232 brasseries.
kpis.description_en: AB InBev total volume 580 Mhl in 2024. #1 global brewer, brewed in 50+ countries via 232 breweries.

kpis.description_fr: EBITDA normalisé 21.7 Mds$ en 2024, marge 36%. Premiumization + revenue management + cost discipline.
kpis.description_en: Normalized EBITDA $21.7B in 2024, 36% margin. Premiumization + revenue management + cost discipline.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Megabrands (Budweiser, Stella Artois, Corona, Brahma, Modelo, Michelob Ultra) 35 Mds$ en 2024. ~60% du CA, leaders catégories.
kpis.description_en: Megabrands revenue (Budweiser, Stella Artois, Corona, Brahma, Modelo, Michelob Ultra) $35B in 2024. ~60% revenue.

kpis.description_fr: GMV via BEES (plateforme B2B AB InBev) 51 Mds$ en 2024. 4.1M acheteurs actifs mensuels, 90% des ventes directes US/Mexique/Brésil.
kpis.description_en: BEES GMV (AB InBev B2B platform) $51B in 2024. 4.1M monthly active buyers, 90% direct sales US/Mexico/Brazil.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio dette nette / EBITDA 2.89x fin 2024, deleveraging continu depuis acquisition SAB Miller. Cible <2x.
kpis.description_en: Net debt to EBITDA 2.89x end-2024, continued deleveraging since SAB Miller acquisition. Target <2x.
